answer_1.quote: We start by implementing an additional gloss-to-text network, applying the wait-k policy tailored for simultaneous (online) machine translation. This allows for online SLT by gradually feeding the gloss predictions generated by our online CSLR model into the wait-k gloss-to-text network.

answer_2.quote: For SLT, we report BLEU-4 scores computed by SacreBLEU (v1.4.2) (Post, 2018).
